title: pinus nigra subsp. mauretanica
intro: Pinus nigra subsp. mauretanica, commonly known as Atlas Black Pine, is a subspecies of evergreen tree native to North Africa, specifically in Morocco and Algeria. The Atlas Black Pine is rich in bioactive constituents such as terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Pinus nigra subsp. mauretanica include its potential to alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and bronchodilator effects, as well as its ability to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which interact with the body's physiological processes to produce its medicinal effects.
